name: Special Collateral 2 Code
definition: Specifies the collateral type against which all repurchase agreements are conducted.

GENE.name: General Collateral
GENE.definition: Identifies that all repurchase agreements are conducted against general collateral.

SPEC.name: Special Collateral
SPEC.definition: Identifies that all repurchase agreements are conducted against special collateral.

MRRP.name: Matched And Reverse Repurchase Agreement
MRRP.definition: Identifies that this is a securities lending transaction, made of repurchase agreements and reverse repurchase agreements versus cash.
